Found- Zephany Nurse missing for 17 years

By: Liz Fish | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
In an emotional exclusive interview Morne and Celeste Nurse speak about the emotional roller coaster of finding their abducted child 17 years later.

Summary:
Celeste Nurse was recovering in hospital from a Cesarean section having given birth to a beautiful baby girl 3 days earlier, baby Zephany alseep in the cot beside her. When she awoke the baby was gone, there was no trace of her. For 17 years Morne and Celeste never gave up hoping, celebrating her birthday every year in the hope of keeping her story alive. In January when their 2nd daughter enrolled at a local High School everybody told her there was a girl in Matric who looked like her. She told her dad, he arranged a coffee date with the two girls and was struck by the resemblance. Morne then tracked her on social media for a month before handing over the evidence to the Hawks. Last week the DNA tests came back positive- the matric pupil was their daughter, Zephany Nurse, last seen at 3 days old, missing for 17 years.

1. John’s first intro is what should be studio intro – take it out and change the intro...
2. You can start with them happy but then take us back to the begin of the story
3. You haven’t shown us the story of their lives
4. We hear as an afterthought that they are divorced.
5. When were they actually reunited? How long has it been since they found her
6. They have other kids – tell us the story of their family.
7. She has another name... we need to say they are all calling her by their original name
8. How did the father spend a month with her? when?
9. How did the grade 8 and Matric form a bond?
10. How many other kids are there when did they get divorced
11. The father says he knew the other dad – what does he think now? add in more of how he knows him
12. Add in that Celeste has friends in their very street...
13. How will they live as a family now if they are divorced?
14. We need to know that the man who is the fake dad wasn’t with the mom when she kidnapped Zephany.
15. Please deliver 10 mins
16. The picture of the two of them with the giant teddy was used far too late.
17. Hide face of abducting woman’s ...dad
18. Refer to them as ‘the abductor’s family’
19. Say that the abductor’s husband was released immediately and is a witness.
20. Why did she jump into his arms we have no context for that...
21. You need to say that the social workers removed her last week and arrested the mum and then they did DNA... and confirmed the suspicions
22. Say that the investigation began a month ago
23. Please show to GM and WYNAND tonight for a second viewing...
24. we don’t like ending on John’s link about the whatsapps please end on something else like the mom saying they can come and visit her. that is a better ending for example...
25. The court details need to come before the ending and then come back to the family and end on the mom.

Press Release:


Celeste and Morné have celebrated their daughter Zephany's birthday every year for 17 years. They celebrated without her. Zephany was taken from the hospital when she was 3 days old. With the kidnapper now in court, Carte Blanche hears from Zephany’s real parents about the daughter they always believed they would find and the astonishing sequence of events that brought her literally to their door.

Script:


Morne: “We can’t get over the feeling that my daughter is back it is amazing”
Celeste: “It never happens”
John: “It doesn’t “
Celeste: “It’s unbelievable, a 3 day old baby being abducted returns it never happens with missing kids”
Script: Morne and Celeste Nurse never gave up hoping this day would arrive, last week the DNA tests done on a teenager confirmed she was their daughter who had been snatched from Celeste hospital bedside 17 years ago
John: “What happened?”
Celeste “A woman came to me I was asleep but because I had a caesarean with Zephany I was under heavy medication. So when I looked at the cot I heard her crying and I saw this woman dressed as a nurse so I though ok it’s the nurse and I was gone, I was sleeping, 4 o’clock the nurse came and she woke me up and she said where is the baby I said what do you mean where is the baby the baby is in the cot she said no the baby is not in the cot. Mommy where is the baby? I said the nurse was here. We were frantic we ran everywhere I took my drip and I ran to each and every floor at Groote Schuur hospital she was gone missing no sign of baby whatsoever only the blanket that she left in the cot baby was gone gone”
John “Dreadful I can’t imagine how you must have felt”
Celeste “It’s a nightmare it’s something that you live with everyday”
Morne : “There was so much anger inside of me I felt like I wanted to explode I didn’t want to speak to Celeste for days I blamed her don’t even want to think about it anymore I just want to cut it completely out of my life”
John: “In that moment do you fear the worst?”
Celeste:” Yes I have I thought what if my child has been sold but I had this in my heart something, I think it was God just telling me hold on”
John: “And did you hold onto that hope?”
Celeste: “ Never, I prayed every night not just for her but for each and every child that is missing every mother who has gone through this, their longing is just the return of my child that is all that you want for the child to have a happy home” …crys
Script: They named their missing baby Zephany after her grandmother and Morne and Celeste went onto have three more children. Each year they celebrated Zephany’s birthday in the hope of keeping her story alive.
Celeste: “It was an emotional day every year on her birthday, but eventually we could show her when she asked Mommy were you searching, this is what we did every year”
Script: Sadly Morne and Celeste got divorced a few years ago.
Link: “ Zephany goes to this school where she is due matriculate at the end of this year now in an extraordinary coincidence her younger sister enrolled at the same school in January of this year as a Grade 8 pupil and they eventually stuck up a friendship”
Morne: “When Cassidy came home when I picked her up she broke the news to say daddy there is a girl at school who actually resembles me completely. I took the initiative and when I went back the next day I said ok make sure you bring her Zephany with you this afternoon when I pick you up. I actually asked myself what connection can there be, what matriculant takes a Grade 8 under the wing”
John: And starts up a friendship”
Morne “Exactly - so the acceptance from Zephane’s side together with Cassidy they were just connected from the word go. The one is calling the other one what we call she is my titi and the other one tells the baby you are my baby girl and they connected from the word go”
Link: Morne met Zephany and her younger sister at this Mac Donalds and like Zephany’s schoolmates he too was immediately struck by the resemblance
Morne” I was over anxious I wanted to know this kid because I felt deep down inside of me yoyh there is this strong connection between me and this kid. “
Script: Morne tracked her on social media for the next month. Morne and Celeste live apart so he sent the images he had found to Celeste to see if she also saw the resemblance
Celeste : “I said this is my daughter this is Cassidy and he said no this is Zephany this is the girl at school and I said this is my daughter because and then he sent me another picture and I said SHE IS MY DAUGHTER ( laugh) and he said I think so as well”
Morne: “There was a witness in 1997 that actually did an identity kit on the mother, the this lady that took the child. I forwarded her the picture onto the witness and the witness immediately got back to me and said Morne that is the lady “
Morne: “Zephany said why do you look like me she also said, I don’t look like my volks, do want to see what they look like and she showed me the phone and I took the phone and I said there is no ways, you don’t look like them and I just left it there and I took it to the higher authorities “
Script: He immediately contacted Col Mike Barkhuisen who has been handling the case.
Morne: “ Mike told me we can’t just do DNAs we will go back to the hospital we will get the original birth certificate…... He came back to me and said Mr Nurse no go there is no dockets nothing there and then they also found the registration of Zephany it only occurred 6 years after her birth…even although they were living in Cape they don’t know why the lady went to Malmsbury to register the child so all facts and all evidence pointed to that is the baby Nurse. They then went to school last week Tuesday and they took Zephany into custody they arrested the mother and the father and that was where the DNA was enforced. We had to wait for about 2 , 3 days
Celeste “ I am still reeling from the shock when they said you are going to be a mother again she is mine oh my word she is my daughter. And then he said you can come meet her, I said I am coming immediately,that was the best that happened in my life ever “
Link: This quite street in Lavenderhill is where young Zephany grew up raised by two people she had no reason to doubt were her parents then late last month the truth was revealed sending shockwaves through this close community
Script: The abductors husband who helped raise Zephany under another name was just as shocked. He’s been released and is now a witness in the trial
Fozia “ Everybody knows her she is quite a very very good woman If children don’t have school clothes she helps everybody .There was one night 3 o’clock in the morning, I went to go knock at their door for help “
Script: Her neighbough for the last six years Fozia Davids says there must be a mistake
Fozia: “She treated her daughter like a queen like a princess …the best clothes best quality for education anything this woman could give for that daughter.”
Script: Pre-school teacher Angie Pontello met Zephany and the abductor when she delivered the tracksuits she had made for the children at the crèche
John “What was your impression that they were happy
Angie “Yes always laughing giggling chatting 17 06 37 That child was always clinging to Levona she believed that that was her mother
Links : Zephany was separated from her biological parents for 17 years but in another bitter twist to this story it turns out that the families lived just 4 kms apart one in Retreat and the other in Lavenderhill
Celeste “We could have lost her, this is her last year in High School and she would have been a gonner we wouldn’t have found her and just to think she was right under our noses oh it’s a scary feeling
Morne “Funny enough when I saw the dad I actually know the guy, he used to buy some goods from me you know “
Celeste: “She used to come in that same road where we stay, because there are friends in that same road. I may even have walked past her
Script: Clinical Psychologist Martin Yodaiken says the euphoria Zephany and her family are feeling is a honeymoon period and they still face enormous emotional turmoil, but because Zephany is nearly 18 she has a better chance
Martin “In all likelihood she will be primary attached to the abducting mother so you can’t just walk out of a primary attachment into a primary attachment of somebody you have not known. So I don’t believe in ripping the child away from the abducting parents I think there is a process there because otherwise it can begin to feel like another abduction
Script: Zephany remains in in a place of safety and Celeste and Morne have been allowed to visit her three times since she was removed from the abductors family
John “And what kind of young person does she strike you as?
Celeste “She is very intelligent, she is a sweet girl. It’s difficult for her to adapt because we are strangers to her but it will take time for us to build a bond which is already happening she already accepted us she calls him dad she calls me mom. It’s just a sad feeling that I have missed out for 17 years that makes me sad.
Morne “I have happened to spend about a month with her so I have built a bond. When we were reunited I walked in she ran she jumped in my arms her mommy was standing right behind me when I moved they met and that to me was priceless there were a lot of tears there was a lot of joy she could believe it – look I have a young mommy.
John “Are you expecting difficulties because you are at the beginning of a new journey now?
Celeste: “There could be, so we are all going to go for counselling we have to go and for the kids sake as well
Morne: “Look the family is definitely much closer
Celeste: “Everyone is overwhelmed and over the moon”
John: “At this stage it’s probably best to take it one step at a time
Celeste “One step at a time”
John: Given the magnitude to what’s at stake
Celeste: One day at a time and not try to push anything
In the mean time the law will takes it course the accused woman has been released on R5000 bail and one of the bail conditions is that she is not allowed any contact what so ever with Zephany that includes telephone calls, emails and even whatsapp messages
Morne “I have got no remorse for what is going to happen to her she did something wrong to the Nurse family but there is forgiveness, to the father I have got no ill feelings really
Celeste: “ This woman who took my daughter I have got no hard feelings towards her. I actually want to say thank you, you have done a good job .They can come and visit Zephany whenever they want even cousins I am not going to keep her away from them

So I don’t believe in ripping the child away from the abducting parents I think there is a process there because otherwise it can begin to feel like another abduction Script: Zephany remains in in a place of safety and Celeste and Morne have been allowed to visit her three times since she was removed from the abductors family John “And what kind of young person does she strike you as? Celeste “She is very intelligent, she is a sweet girl. It’s difficult for her to adapt because we are strangers to her but it will take time for us to build a bond which is already happening she already accepted us she calls him dad she calls me mom. It’s just a sad feeling that I have missed out for 17 years that makes me sad. Morne “I have happened to spend about a month with her so I have built a bond. When we were reunited I walked in she ran she jumped in my arms her mommy was standing right behind me when I moved they met and that to me was priceless there were a lot of tears there was a lot of joy she could believe it – look I have a young mommy. John “Are you expecting difficulties because you are at the beginning of a new journey now? Celeste: “There could be, so we are all going to go for counselling we have to go and for the kids sake as well Morne: “Look the family is definitely much closer Celeste: “Everyone is overwhelmed and over the moon” John: “At this stage it’s probably best to take it one step at a time Celeste “One step at a time” John: Given the magnitude to what’s at stake Celeste: One day at a time and not try to push anything In the mean time the law will takes it course the accused woman has been released on R5000 bail and one of the bail conditions is that she is not allowed any contact what so ever with Zephany that includes telephone calls, emails and even whatsapp messages Morne “I have got no remorse for what is going to happen to her she did something wrong to the Nurse family but there is forgiveness, to the father I have got no ill feelings really Celeste: “ This woman who took my daughter I have got no hard feelings towards her. metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): In an emotional exclusive interview Morne and Celeste Nurse speak about the emotional roller coaster of finding their abducted child 17 years later.
metadata.Summary: Celeste Nurse was recovering in hospital from a Cesarean section having given birth to a beautiful baby girl 3 days earlier, baby Zephany alseep in the cot beside her. When she awoke the baby was gone, there was no trace of her. For 17 years Morne and Celeste never gave up hoping, celebrating her birthday every year in the hope of keeping her story alive. In January when their 2nd daughter enrolled at a local High School everybody told her there was a girl in Matric who looked like her. She told her dad, he arranged a coffee date with the two girls and was struck by the resemblance. Morne then tracked her on social media for a month before handing over the evidence to the Hawks. Last week the DNA tests came back positive- the matric pupil was their daughter, Zephany Nurse, last seen at 3 days old, missing for 17 years.
